label: MUTABLE_2: a life boundary requires potency, through another's power and a sense bridge
description: MUTABLE_2 (THROUGH_ANOTHER) branch of the boundary use: whatever begins or ceases to live is in another being's power, and (explicit sense bridge) whatever is in another's power is in potency in itself; so whatever begins or ceases to live is in potency in itself in some respect, the root-route node. The controls give a model in which the MUTABLE_2 premise holds, the bridge fails and the node fails.
